analytics.name: Analytic 1724
analytics.guidance: Defender correlates an iOS-specific reduced-confidence chain where a supervised or managed device transitions from locked or inactive state to interactive or application-active state with weak evidence of expected user authentication, often accompanied by abnormal protected posture change, trust-state change, unexpected app wake, sensor use, or immediate downstream communication. Because direct visibility into lockscreen bypass mechanics on iOS is limited, the analytic prioritizes strong device-state effects and post-unlock behavior rather than pretending to observe the exact bypass method.

tuning.description: Maximum allowed span between locked or inactive device state, suspicious app/service activity, and interactive transition.

Apps expected to access camera or biometric-adjacent resources near the authentication boundary.
Expected destinations contacted immediately after legitimate app activation post-authentication.
Threshold for suspicious immediate outbound traffic after suspicious unlock-adjacent activity.
